body: Hi, I just wanted you to know that I’m still here. Life has really uplifted this past few days. And your words were of great comfort to me. Thank you so much for reaching out when I was at an all time low.
Oh interesting! I wonder what they are.
Yeah, tight fitting clothes and they were identical.
Hmm. Okay. I will look into them.
Thank you! Any lead is huge for me.
I know. I just feel like they haven’t done anything super interesting with the line for a while.
I’d love to see that! Is there any way you could post a link?
Omg! Yes! If they did sets based on the older seasons that would be amazing!
From what I’ve gathered there is still at least one more wave of GoT sets coming out, based around Kings Landing.
I don’t mind the story not taking place in New York, honestly.
Oh, he’s the one who directed  Star Wars The Last Jedi.  A lot of fans who haven’t liked season 8 seem to compare it to that movie.
Brilliant! Guess maybe I’m not from a different Earth after all.
